name: 360Giving
what: 360Giving is an UK charity that helps grantmakers publish and use open grants data through the 360Giving Data Standard and GrantNav. It is now part of Funders Together.

name: Apps for Good
what: Apps for Good is a UK education charity providing free computing, AI and essential-skills courses for schools. Its new AI for Good 2.0 course has students build AI-powered apps for social impact.
tags: education; courses; young people; digital skills

name: Big Brother Watch
what: Big Brother Watch is a UK civil liberties campaign group focused on privacy, surveillance, facial recognition and free speech.

name: Centre for Public Data
what: The Centre for Public Data is a non-profit, non-partisan advocacy organisation working for stronger public data: data collected, published or regulated by government. It works with policymakers, parliamentarians and organisations to identify data gaps and improve legislation.

name: Citizens Advice
what: Citizens Advice is a national charity giving free, independent advice on benefits, debt, housing, employment, consumer and legal problems through its website and a network of local offices.

name: Code Club
what: Code Club is a global network of free coding clubs for young people and part of the Raspberry Pi Foundation. It provides projects, training and support for the volunteers who run clubs.

name: CoTech
what: CoTech is a UK-wide network of worker-owned technology and digital service cooperatives. It was founded at Wortley Hall in 2016 and became the first sector-specific arm of the workers.coop federation in September 2024.
source: Homepage and recent update at https://www.cotech.coop/conference-2026 (verified 2026-11-10).

name: Crisis
what: Crisis is a national UK charity for people experiencing homelessness, running services and campaigning for the policy changes needed to end homelessness.

name: data.gov.uk
what: Data.gov.uk is the UK government's public data catalogue, now being transformed into the National Data Library. It is run by GDS in the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology and still hosts the directory where public bodies publish datasets.
source: Homepage and recent update at https://dataingovernment.blog.gov.uk/2026/03/25/whats-changing-on-data-gov-uk-and-why/; activity also at https://dataingovernment.blog.gov.uk/2026/07/14/improving-support-for-people-at-risk-through-better-data-introducing-the-vulnerabilities-data-standards-alpha/ (verified 2026-11-10).

name: Democracy Club
what: Democracy Club is a non-partisan UK community interest company that produces election data, runs WhoCanIVoteFor and WhereDoIVote, and publishes candidate and polling-station data for reuse.
tags: elections; open data; civic tech; voting
source: Homepage and recent update at https://democracyclub.org.uk/blog/2026/06/23/case-study-votewales-and-polling-place-accessibility/; activity also at https://democracyclub.org.uk/blog/2026/10/15/english-council-boundary-reviews-on-whocanivotefor/ (verified 2026-11-10).

name: Full Fact
what: Full Fact is an independent UK fact-checking charity that checks claims made online and in public debate, and works with platforms, regulators and researchers to reduce harm from bad information.

name: Good Things Foundation
what: Good Things Foundation is a UK digital inclusion charity running the National Digital Inclusion Network, National Databank, National Device Bank, Learn My Way and the AI Gateway.
tags: digital inclusion; digital skills; devices; charity

name: Government Digital Service
what: The Government Digital Service is the UK government's digital centre, building and setting standards for public services including GOV.UK, GOV.UK One Login and GOV.UK Pay.
tags: govtech; public services; standards; digital government

name: Green Web Foundation
what: Green Web Foundation is a Dutch non-profit working towards a fossil-free internet by 2030. It maintains an open dataset of websites running on green energy and builds tools including CO2.js and carbon.txt.

name: Homeless Link
what: Homeless Link is a national membership charity for organisations working with people who become homeless in England, providing training, consultancy, data and policy advocacy.

name: Liberty
what: Liberty is a UK civil liberties organisation that campaigns, litigates and advocates on human rights, including privacy, surveillance and free expression.
tags: civil liberties; human rights; litigation; campaigning

name: LocalGov Digital
what: LocalGov Digital is a network for digital practitioners working in and around UK local government, with more than 3,000 members. It runs an online community, events and shared resources for councils.

name: mySociety
what: MySociety is a UK charity, established in 2003, that builds and runs digital services such as FixMyStreet, TheyWorkForYou and WhatDoTheyKnow to help people participate in civic life and hold institutions to account.
tags: civic tech; democracy; research; open source
source: Homepage and recent update at https://www.mysociety.org/impact-report-2026/; activity also at https://www.mysociety.org/2026/09/28/from-volunteer-to-town-councillor-with-the-council-climate-action-scorecards/ (verified 2026-11-10).

name: Office for National Statistics
what: Office for National Statistics is the UK's national statistical institute and largest independent producer of official statistics. It publishes over 600 releases a year on the economy, society and population.
tags: official statistics; open data; government; population

name: Open Climate Fix
what: Open Climate Fix is a non-profit building open-source machine-learning forecasts for solar, wind, and cloud movements so electricity grids can use more renewable power. Its GB solar forecast is used by the National Energy System Operator.

name: Open Data Institute
what: Open Data Institute is a london-based non-profit founded in 2012 by Sir Tim Berners-Lee and Sir Nigel Shadbolt. It works on data infrastructure, research, policy, consultancy and training to build trust in data.
tags: open data; research; policy; data ethics

name: Open Data Manchester
what: Open Data Manchester helps people, organisations and communities use data better through advice, advocacy, events, research and training.
tags: open data; training; community; greater manchester

name: Open Innovations
what: Open Innovations was a Leeds-based not-for-profit open-data organisation. It stopped taking new work in May 2026 and its tools, data and blog remain online as an archive.

name: Open Rights Group
what: Open Rights Group is a UK grassroots digital rights campaigning organisation working to protect privacy and free speech online. It campaigns on surveillance, data protection, AI and the effects of technology on people's rights.
tags: digital rights; privacy; free speech; campaigning

name: OpenSAFELY
what: OpenSAFELY is a platform for analysing sensitive NHS records safely, built and maintained by the Bennett Institute at the University of Oxford with NHS England, TPP, Optum and collaborators.
tags: health data; research; privacy; open source
source: Homepage and recent update at https://www.opensafely.org/; activity also at https://www.bennett.ox.ac.uk/blog/2026/10/reflections-from-the-2026-public-engagement-in-data-research-initiative-pedri-forum/ (verified 2026-11-10).

name: OpenUK
what: OpenUK is a not-for-profit convening UK business, academia and technologists across open source, open hardware, open data, open standards and AI openness.
tags: open source; open standards; open data; advocacy
source: Homepage and recent update at https://openuk.uk/report/aiopenness2026/ (verified 2026-11-10).

name: Privacy International
what: Privacy International is a London-based charity working on technology and human rights, with a focus on surveillance and the exploitation of personal data. It has worked on privacy since 1990.

name: Raspberry Pi Foundation
what: Raspberry Pi Foundation is a UK charity that helps young people realise their potential through computing and digital technologies, publishing free learning resources and supporting clubs, teachers and Coolest Projects.

name: RNIB
what: RNIB is the UK's leading sight loss charity, providing practical and emotional support to blind and partially sighted people and campaigning for accessible products and services. It also runs specialist services including Talking Books and RNIB Connect Radio.

name: Scope
what: Scope is a disability equality charity in England and Wales providing practical information, support, and campaigns on the barriers disabled people face. It runs a helpline, disability energy service, and charity shops.

name: Shelter England
what: Shelter England is a housing and homelessness charity in England providing advice, legal support and emergency helpline services, and campaigning for housing policy change.

name: The Restart Project
what: The Restart Project is a people-powered social enterprise running community repair events, Fixing Factories and repair directories. It campaigns for the right to repair.
tags: right to repair; electronics; waste; community

name: TheyWorkForYou
what: TheyWorkForYou is a mySociety civic-tech service that makes Hansard, votes and representatives searchable across the UK's parliaments.
source: Homepage and recent update at https://www.mysociety.org/2026/07/01/theyworkforyou-voting-summaries-update-july-2026/; activity also at https://www.theyworkforyou.com/ (verified 2026-11-10).

name: Turn2us
what: Turn2us is a UK charity helping people facing financial insecurity. It runs a benefits calculator, a charitable grants search and direct grant programmes, and says its roots stretch back to 1897.
